plan.summary: DIR-077 P0 recon complete, every finding cited to file:line. INVARIANTS AND CONTRACT BOUNDARIES: XAMPP-only servers (no detached node/vite daemon); preserve dir074, dir075, dir076, cuba-candidate-portal and cuba-design-system, plus the dir048-shell-and-controls container pin and the dir009 and dir-001 E2E hooks (data-testid cuba-candidate-hero, .cuba-stat-card); zero fabrication; no auth or token change; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors; 55 frozen CV templates diff 0. RCA AND FINDINGS: (1) CubaAppShell.jsx:512 caps the content at mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl px-4 py-6 pb-24 sm:px-6 md:pb-6 lg:px-8, so on a 1680px+ viewport roughly 30 percent of the width is wasted; tests/dir048-shell-and-controls.test.mjs:51 asserts that exact string, so it must be updated in lockstep. (2) CubaAppShell.jsx:285-306 the header left rail holds the 40px collapse toggle then the breadcrumbs, so the trail starts about 40px from the edge and floats OVER the 260px sidebar header instead of anchoring the main workspace column. (3) CubaAppShell.jsx:423-460 the aside stacks the IME365 brand tile row behind a border-b and then a SECOND border-b block for ContextSwitcher variant sidebar, creating redundant nested borders and an awkward stacked gap. (4) CubaCandidateShell.jsx:452-463 the /dashboard overview stacks Hero, AiCareerBriefing and children in one space-y-6 column, leaving the right void empty on wide screens. (5) CubaCandidateHero.jsx:120-127 renders the cartoon mascot /images/dashboard/cartoon.svg. (6) CubaCandidateHero.jsx:229-270 the four CubaStatCards are text-only. (7) CubaStatCard.jsx:57-121 has no visual slot. CHANGES: (1) raise the container cap to max-w-[1680px] w-full keeping the responsive gutter, and update the dir048 assertion; (2) relocate the M3Breadcrumbs rail into the main content container so it anchors the main column at its left edge while keeping exactly one breadcrumb nav; (3) merge the brand tile and ContextSwitcher into ONE cohesive executive pill with a single divider and no stacked gaps, preserving the collapsed brand tile, the /dashboard link, the border-l-0 md:flex aside class and the CubaNavGroups call; (4) refactor the /dashboard overview on the 1280px xl breakpoint into a 2-column executive grid - main workspace column about 70 percent (Hero, Document Gallery, Onboarding) and an executive right rail about 30 percent with three REAL widgets (Live Copilot Quick-Pitch actions from getCopilotActions, ATS Keyword Strength Radar, Application Milestone Tracker from getStatesOfUser and getTrackedJobs), stacking to one column below xl; (5) replace cartoon.svg with a bespoke Cuba glassmorphism SVG career-telemetry visual; (6) add native SVG micro-visuals - a circular radial gauge for Average ATS Score, a progress bar for Active Resumes and a pipeline stepper for Job Applications. ACCESSIBILITY (WCAG 2.1 AA): keep one header and one breadcrumb nav, give every SVG gauge role=img with an aria-label, use role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax on the progress bar, aria-current on the stepper step, preserve cuba-focusable keyboard focus rings and keep contrast at or above 4.5:1 with Cuba tokens. UX STATES: every new rail widget renders a CubaSkeleton loading state, a CubaEmptyState when the account genuinely has no data and an error banner on failure, never a fabricated zero. RESPONSIVE: the grid collapses to a single column below the 1280px breakpoint and is validated at 375px mobile, 768px tablet, 1280px desktop and 1680px wide. PERFORMANCE: the rail reuses the hero already-fetched data through one shared memo so there is no new fetch waterfall and no extra re-render loop, and the inline SVG micro-visuals cause no layout thrash, keeping the sub-100ms render budget and the sub-4s build. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: AC1 container cap is max-w-[1680px] w-full; AC2 breadcrumbs anchor the main column with exactly one breadcrumb nav; AC3 the sidebar brand and switcher are unified with no stacked border-b; AC4 the 1280px grid shows the main column plus the three rail widgets; AC5 cartoon.svg is gone and the telemetry SVG is present; AC6 the radial gauge, progress bar and pipeline stepper exist; AC7 all pinned suites pass; AC8 build under 4s; AC9 lint 0 errors; AC10 the 55 frozen CV templates diff 0.
